_source: specs/source/Oracle_P2P_E2E_Manual_Test_Script.docx (stages S0-S8, appendices A-D) aligned to the automation Tests/TC_P2P_E2E.xaml (S0-S9 workflows). Step ids follow the automation stages; the docx stage is given in brackets where it differs.
name: P2P E2E: supplier registration to validated invoice (Oracle Fusion, US1, Casey Brown)
description:
End-to-end Oracle Fusion procure-to-pay regression on the dev16 demo pod (US1 Business Unit), from the Deloitte walkthrough of 23 Nov 2026 (Oracle_P2P_E2E_Manual_Test_Script.docx): register and approve a new supplier, raise and approve a non-catalog requisition for that supplier, stage and publish it into a purchase order, submit the PO (auto-approves), receive it, then create, match and validate the supplier invoice. Payment is out of scope.

Automation: package OF-AT-RobP, entry point Tests\TC_P2P_E2E, folder Shared/OracleFusion. Each run generates a RunId (yyMMddHHmm) for unique values, records each stage in the Data Fabric entity OracleP2PRun (TestMarker UIP-TEST-<RunId>), and cleans up through the Fusion REST API.

Differences from the recording: the requisition uses the newly registered supplier (the recording used Dell Inc. / Dell US1); approvals are done from the Notifications bell; supplier and requisition approver is Casey Brown (self-approval in this environment).
preCondition:
1. Oracle Fusion dev16 reachable: https://fa-eqjz-dev16-saasfademo1.ds-fa.oraclepdemos.com/fscmUI/faces/FuseWelcome
2. Credential asset Oracle_Fusion_P2P_Test (folder Shared/OracleFusion) signs in as CASEY.BROWN, who holds requester, supplier registration, buyer, receiving and Payables roles and is the supplier and requisition approver in this environment.
3. A small file for the mandatory questionnaire attachment (Data\Questionnaire_Attachment.docx).
4. Unique run values: RunId = yyMMddHHmm; Supplier = 'UIPTST Supplier <RunId>'; Taxpayer ID = <RunId>; bank account number = MMddHHmm; invoice number = 'UIP-OFP2P-<RunId>'.
5. Casey's requisition cart is empty (park any leftover requisition with Save for Later).
postCondition: Run documents cleaned up: invoice canceled; PO canceled, or closed when received/invoiced; requisition canceled where Oracle allows (it stays Approved once its lines are on a PO, POR-2010924). The new supplier is left active. OracleP2PRun record for the RunId ends at Stage CleanedUp with the requisition, PO and invoice numbers.

steps.d: S0.1 Open the Fusion URL in Chrome. On Cloud Sign In enter the username and password from credential asset Oracle_Fusion_P2P_Test and click Next.
steps.e: Oracle Fusion home page loads (the first Redwood load after sign-in can take up to 2 minutes).

steps.d: S0.2 Check the home page greeting.
steps.e: 'Good morning/afternoon/evening, Casey Brown' is shown.

steps.d: S1.1 Open Supplier Management and click Register Supplier (Actions panel). If a 'draft exists' dialog appears for Casey's own earlier draft, click Start Over.
steps.e: Supplier Registration wizard opens on page 1 Company Details; the URL carries a SupplierRegId.

steps.d: S1.2 Company Details: Company = UIPTST Supplier <RunId>; Business Relationship = Spend Authorized (default is Prospective); Procurement BU = US1 Business Unit; Request Reason = New Supply Source; Country = New Zealand; Taxpayer ID = <RunId>; Organization Type = Corporation. Click Continue.
steps.e: Page counter shows 7 pages after the Procurement BU is chosen; Contacts page opens with no 'Required' hints left. If 'Error response during RestAction' appears, refresh and re-enter.

steps.d: S1.3 Contacts: First Name = Contact, Last Name = 1, Email = 1@1.com. Leave 'Is this an administrative contact?' = Yes and 'Does this contact need a user account?' = Yes (all roles ticked). Click Continue.
steps.e: Addresses page opens.

steps.d: S1.4 Addresses: Address Name = HQ; tick Receive Purchase Orders and Receive Payments; Enter Address '216 Queen Street Northcote Point Auckland 0627' and pick the suggestion; tick Contact 1 under associated contacts. Click Continue.
steps.e: Business Classifications page opens (no 'Select at least 1 purpose' or 'Enter at least one address' messages).

steps.d: S1.5 Business Classifications: Classification = Veteran Owned. Click Continue.
steps.e: Bank Accounts page opens.

steps.d: S1.6 Bank Accounts: Country = New Zealand (defaults from the tax country); Branch Number = 1010; Account Number = <MMddHHmm>; Account Holder and Account Suffix (00) as per test data. Click Continue.
steps.e: Bank = ANZ Bank and Bank Branch = Queen Street Branch auto-fill; Products and Services page opens.

steps.d: S1.7 Products and Services: tick Healthcare. Click Continue.
steps.e: '1 selected' is shown; Questionnaire page opens.

steps.d: S1.8 Questionnaire: select 'a. Full Compliance'; click Add Attachments, upload Data\Questionnaire_Attachment.docx in 'Response attachments for question 1', close the panel. Click Submit.
steps.e: Counter shows 'Add Attachments (1)' and Submit becomes enabled; the request is submitted.

steps.d: S1.9 Check the result on Supplier Management.
steps.e: Toast 'Registration request submitted'. Registration id is captured.

steps.d: S2.1 (Optional) Supplier Management > Supplier Registrations: search for UIPTST Supplier <RunId>.
steps.e: Request is Pending Approval: US1 Business Unit, Spend Authorized, Internal Request, requested by Casey Brown.

steps.d: S2.2 As the supplier approver (Casey Brown here) open the Notifications bell and find 'Supplier Registration Request <n> for UIPTST Supplier <RunId>' under Action Required. Refresh until it arrives (usually 30 s to a few minutes).
steps.e: The approval notification is listed (route: parallel, first responder wins).

steps.d: S2.3 Approve the registration (Approve on the notification, or open it > Approve > Submit in the dialog).
steps.e: Task completes; FYI 'Supplier Registration Request <n> for UIPTST Supplier <RunId> Was Approved'. Supplier is created as Spend Authorized.

steps.d: S3.1 Open Purchase Requisitions (Self Service Procurement, US1 Business Unit | Seattle). If the Cart already holds a requisition, park it with Cart > More Actions > Save for Later.
steps.e: Cart is empty.

steps.d: S3.2 Create Noncatalog Request: Item Description = 'UIP-TEST-<RunId> UI Path Item'; Item Type = Goods billed by quantity; Category = 206.61 Monitors (not 204.54 Laptops, which adds a hardware approver); Quantity = 1; UOM = Ea; Price = 2,000.00; Currency = USD; Supplier = UIPTST Supplier <RunId>.
steps.e: Supplier Site defaults from the new supplier (HQ); no field errors.

steps.d: S3.3 Click Add to Cart.
steps.e: Confirmation 'Request added to cart'; Cart badge = 1.

steps.d: S3.4 Open the Cart.
steps.e: Requisition number shown; line 'UIP-TEST-<RunId> UI Path Item', 2,000.00 Ea; Subtotal 2,000.00, Nonrecoverable Tax 190.00, Approval Amount 2,190.00; Requester Casey Brown, Deliver-to Seattle, charge account derived from the category.

steps.d: S3.5 Select the line and click Submit.
steps.e: Requisition shows 'Pending approval' in My Requisitions. Requisition number is captured.

steps.d: S3.6 (Optional) Requisition > More Actions > View Approvers.
steps.e: Pending approval by Casey Brown (Header Hierarchy: RequisitionApprovalCaseyBrown). 'Can't show approvers right now' straight after submit is normal; retry.

steps.d: S4.1 As the requisition approver (Casey Brown here) open the Notifications bell and find 'Approve Requisition <RequisitionNo>'. Refresh until it arrives.
steps.e: Notification is listed; the task shows 2,190.00 USD, Brown, Casey, the item description and the charge account.

steps.d: S4.2 Approve the requisition (Approve on the notification, or open it > Approve > Submit).
steps.e: Requisition status becomes Approved.

steps.d: S5.1 [doc S5] Open Process Requisitions (New) (not the classic page). Search for the requisition number; refresh until the approved line is listed; tick the line.
steps.e: Line shows the item, 206.61 Monitors, supplier UIPTST Supplier <RunId>, 1 Ea, 2,000.00 USD.

steps.d: S5.2 Click Stage.
steps.e: 'Staged document created'; Staged Document shows Sourcing Method Place order, Procurement BU US1 Business Unit, Document Style Purchase Order, the new supplier and site, Currency USD, Action New Order.

steps.d: S5.3 Click Publish.
steps.e: 'Purchase order <n> created'; the staged document closes.

steps.d: S5.4 [doc S6] Open Purchase Orders (New), search by the requisition number and open the PO.
steps.e: Purchase Order US<n> (Incomplete): supplier UIPTST Supplier <RunId>, buyer, line 1 206.61 Monitors, 1 Ea, 2,000.00; total 2,190.00 USD. PO number is captured.

steps.d: S5.5 Click Submit.
steps.e: 'Purchase order submitted'; status Pending Approval, then Open (auto-approved by the PO self-approval rule).

steps.d: S6.1 [doc S7] Open My Receipts (New) (Show More > My Receipts (New)), search for the PO number and refresh until the line is receivable.
steps.e: Orders to Receive shows US1 Business Unit, the PO, the item, Ordered 1, Received to Date 0, Ea, the new supplier.

steps.d: S6.2 Tick the line and click Receive Now (receives the full quantity).
steps.e: 'Creating receipt' then 'Receipt <n> created'; My Receipts shows the receipt, Received 1 Ea.

steps.d: S7.1 [doc S8] Open Payables > Invoices (classic workbench), open the Tasks panel (right edge) and click Create Invoice.
steps.e: Create Invoice page opens.

steps.d: S7.2 Identifying PO = the PO number, then Tab (confirm the PO in the search dialog if it appears).
steps.e: Business Unit US1 Business Unit, Supplier UIPTST Supplier <RunId>, supplier site and Legal Entity US1 Legal Entity are filled in.

steps.d: S7.3 Number = UIP-OFP2P-<RunId>; Amount = 2,190.00 (2,000.00 plus 9.5% tax). Type stays Standard.
steps.e: Values accepted; date defaults to the tenant date.

steps.d: S7.4 Lines: Match Invoice Lines > Go. Tick the PO line (line 1, schedule 1, unit price 2,000.00); accept the self-billing warning with OK if shown; click Apply, then OK.
steps.e: Line 1 Item 2,000.00 is matched to the PO line 1 schedule 1, ship-to Seattle; Items total 2,000.00.

steps.d: S7.5 Invoice Actions > Validate.
steps.e: Status 'Validated'; Tax 190.00 calculated; Total 2,190.00; no holds.

steps.d: S7.6 Save and Close, then find the invoice in Manage Invoices by its number.
steps.e: Invoice 2,190.00 USD, Validated, Holds 0, approval Not required, line matched to the PO.

steps.d: S9.1 Clean up the run's documents: cancel the invoice; cancel the PO, or close it when it has receipts or invoices; cancel the requisition. Leave the new supplier active.
steps.e: Invoice Canceled (amount 0); PO Closed (or Canceled); requisition stays Approved because its lines are on the PO (POR-2010924, expected); supplier still Active. Automation: OracleP2PRun record for the RunId shows Stage CleanedUp.
